# atlassian_jira_project (Resource)

Manage a Jira project (create, update, delete).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atlassian_jira_project" "example" {
  key         = "DEMO"
  name        = "Demo Project"
  description = "Created by Terraform"
}

output "project_id" {
  value = atlassian_jira_project.example.id
}

output "project_key" {
  value = atlassian_jira_project.example.key
}
```

## Import

Import by project ID or key. The resource block must exist in config before importing.

```bash
terraform import atlassian_jira_project.my_proj DEMO
# or by numeric ID
terraform import atlassian_jira_project.my_proj 10003
```

**Import ID:** project key (e.g. `DEMO`) or numeric project ID (e.g. `10003`). See [Importing resources](../import.md) for more.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Project key (e.g. PROJ). Immutable after create.
- `name` (String) Project name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Project description.
- `lead_account_id` (String) Atlassian account ID of the project lead. If not set, the authenticated user (provider credentials) is used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project ID (set after create).
